claim: Speed up a Z80 divide loop by stepping 8 bits at a time with the divisor negated.

evidence.text: div32 and proj1 by 8-bit steps with the divisor negated: 1,967 to 970 T; the PUSH run starts from an end of either parity.
evidence.quote: div32 and proj1 by 8-bit steps with the divisor negated (1,967 -> 970 T)
